title: Balancing Thomas
statementMd:
Thomas has been studying physics, and recently he learned about levers and torque. As practice, he has been experimenting by placing identical weights on a lever to see what balances. Since the weights are identical, he can keep track of his setup with a binary string of odd length, where the `1`s represent where weights are located, and the middle index is the position under which the lever's fulcrum is located. Thomas's current configuration of weights might not be balanced, and he wants to put in as little effort as possible to extend it to a configuration that will balance.

Formally, we define a binary string to be an equilibrium string if it has odd length and satisfies $\sum_{i \in W} (i-m) = 0$ where $m$ is the index of the midpoint of the string and $W$ is the set of indices having `1`s. Given a binary string representing Thomas's current configuration of weights, your task is to find the length of the shortest equilibrium string of which the given string is a prefix.

Below is an example calculation of a binary string that is not an equilibrium string. However, by adding two characters onto the end, it can be made into one. In fact, we cannot turn the first string into an equilibrium string with any shorter extension.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd5add1e823f9a676b194865b222c78d93326fcb.png)

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case consists of a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the length of the binary string.

The second line of each test case consists of a single string of length $n$, where each character is either a `0` or `1`.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output a single integer — the length of the shortest equilibrium string of which the given string is a prefix.

## Note

For the first test case, the shortest equilibrium string having the input as a prefix is of length 7, and one example is shown in the picture above.

In the second test case, we can convert `100011` into `1000110`.

The third test case is already an equilibrium string, so we need not extend it.
statementZhMd:
托马斯一直在学习物理，最近他学到了杠杆和力矩。为了练习，他开始尝试在杠杆上放置相同的砝码，观察怎样才能保持平衡。由于砝码都相同，他可以用一个长度为奇数的二进制字符串记录摆放情况，其中 `1` 表示该位置放有砝码，字符串的中间位置则是杠杆支点所在的位置。托马斯当前的砝码摆放可能并不平衡，他希望尽可能省力地将其扩展为平衡状态。

形式化地，我们称一个二进制字符串为平衡字符串，当且仅当它的长度为奇数，且满足 $\sum_{i \in W} (i-m) = 0$，其中 $m$ 是字符串中间位置的下标，$W$ 是所有字符为 `1` 的位置下标集合。给定一个表示托马斯当前砝码摆放情况的二进制字符串，你的任务是求最短的平衡字符串长度，使得给定字符串是它的前缀。

下面展示了一个非平衡二进制字符串的计算示例。不过，在末尾添加两个字符后，它就可以变成平衡字符串。事实上，无法通过添加更少的字符将第一个字符串变成平衡字符串。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd5add1e823f9a676b194865b222c78d93326fcb.png)

## 输入格式

每个输入包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$），表示二进制字符串的长度。

每个测试用例的第二行包含一个长度为 $n$ 的字符串，其中每个字符均为 `0` 或 `1`。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数，表示最短的平衡字符串长度，使得给定字符串是它的前缀。

## 说明

对于第一个测试用例，以输入字符串为前缀的最短平衡字符串长度为 7，图中给出了一个例子。

对于第二个测试用例，可以将 `100011` 转换为 `1000110`。

第三个测试用例已经是平衡字符串，因此无需扩展。
